estimands.definition_obligation: Only under an applicable rare-event construction.
estimands.label: Action / rate functional

estimands.definition_obligation: Target event/quantity for genealogical continuity; not mediation.
estimands.label: Ancestry-related functional

estimands.definition_obligation: Entry-to-next-exit sojourn, conditional entry and censoring.
estimands.label: Episode duration

estimands.definition_obligation: Probability of satisfying the declared establishment event by the horizon, not automatically persistence.
estimands.label: Establishment probability

estimands.definition_obligation: Time a separately declared establishment rule is satisfied; no universal threshold.
estimands.label: Establishment time

estimands.definition_obligation: Entry to a predeclared target, with time zero and non-entry conventions.
estimands.label: First entry time

estimands.definition_obligation: Set of target values compatible with data, model set and assumptions.
estimands.label: Identification set

estimands.definition_obligation: Predeclared functional under two explicitly typed interventions.
estimands.label: Intervention contrast

estimands.definition_obligation: Fraction of time or state probability; distinguish time average from uninterrupted residence.
estimands.label: Occupation / state occupancy

estimands.definition_obligation: Probability of staying within the target throughout the declared horizon.
estimands.label: Uninterrupted persistence probability

estimands.definition_obligation: Re-entry after exit with origin/source specification.
estimands.label: Recurrence / return

estimands.definition_obligation: Error for a declared target under a scale projection, norm and horizon.
estimands.label: Reduction error

estimands.definition_obligation: Model-defined current; not synonymous with probability or reachability.
estimands.label: Route flux

estimands.definition_obligation: Probability of declared route class under a justified path law.

estimands.definition_obligation: Conditioning risk set, clock, competing exits and sampling process.
